title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — Fee on a Next-Business-Day Bank Transfer
content:
**Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — the bank transfer fee.**

**The fee.** The bank transfer fee is the tier's next-business-day bank fee, reduced to the bank fee room when the room is smaller, never below zero, and rounded half up to the cent, except that the first next-business-day bank transfer of a pay period, the only transfer to a bank account carrying its pay date, carries no fee; when the fee comes to zero no fee entry is booked.

**The bank fee room.** The tier's fee ceiling per pay period less the amount of the plan's fees carrying the transfer's pay date net of the fee reversals carrying that pay date. For the bank transfer fee the period fee cap applies through the bank fee room.

**The transfer priced.** The transfer read is the plan's latest transfer of the day, the one booked today with the highest daily sequence: its amount, its pay date and its record.

**Order of operation.** Adjustments are applied in this order: any that decides whether the transfer carries no fee first, then any that sets the fee charged in place of the tier's next-business-day bank fee, then any amount added to that fee, and the result is compared with the bank fee room as measured under any adjustment that measures it, before rounding half up to the cent.

## Hypothetical worked cases (plan on Paystride Access Plus: next-business-day bank fee 1.49 USD, fee ceiling 11.99 USD)

| Case | Bank transfers carrying the pay date | Fees net of reversals already carrying the pay date | Room | Fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | this one only | 3.49 USD | 8.50 USD | no fee (first bank transfer of the period) |
| B | this one and an earlier one | 3.49 USD | 8.50 USD | 1.49 USD |
| C | this one and an earlier one | 10.98 USD | 1.01 USD | 1.01 USD |
| D | this one and an earlier one | 11.99 USD | 0.00 USD | zero: no fee entry is booked |

In case C the room of 11.99 less 10.98, 1.01 USD, is smaller than 1.49 USD, so the fee is reduced to it.
